summary: Skills collection bundling third-party scripts with network fetches
details: Package ships a collection of bundled 'skills' containing helper scripts. Static pattern matches fire on ordinary network operations in these bundled resources: a Python scraper base class and its Flask-style API server (bundled-skills/junta-leiloeiros/) making documented GET/POST calls, a benchmark runner script (bundled-skills/loki-mode/benchmarks/run-benchmarks.sh), an rclone installer helper that runs curl against rclone.org (bundled-skills/rclone-cli/scripts/install.sh:15), and a verify.sh that curls YouTube-related endpoints (bundled-skills/youtube-notetaker/scripts/verify.sh). None of these scripts are wired to npm lifecycle hooks and none execute on package install or require; they are inert data files that only run if a user of the skills collection explicitly invokes them. The destinations observed (rclone.org, YouTube) match the declared purpose of each skill. No credential harvesting, no environment scraping, no hardcoded attacker C2, no obfuscation, and no install-time or import-time execution path is present.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
